name: Smithery
summary: Smithery is a public directory of MCP servers, now owned by Arcade.dev. Until October 2026 it also hosted and proxied MCP servers and managed user connections; those services shut down on October 31, 2026, leaving smithery.ai as a non-proxied directory that links to vendors' own MCP URLs.
facts: API, Connect, Toolbox, CLI, SDKs, MCP proxy (2026-10-31)
Public directory with direct vendor MCP URLs
goodFor: Finding MCP servers and their official URLs
watchOut: Hosted connections stop working on 2026-10-31; migrate before then
No longer a place to host or proxy your own server
Arcade is the suggested replacement for prebuilt integrations
